{{Top}}
A '''construction droid''' was a type of [[Class five droid/Legends|class 5]] [[Droid/Legends|droid]] used in construction projects. Notable models included the [[EVS Construction Droid]] and the [[I-C2 Civil-Industrial Droid/Legends|Civil-Industrial I-C2 construction droid]]. The [[Death Star II/Legends|second Death Star]] was largely constructed using self-replicating construction droids.
